title: Enabling Local Inventory Ads by Default for Shopping Campaigns starting on August 31, 2026
titleOriginal: Enabling Local Inventory Ads by Default for Shopping Campaigns starting on August 31, 2026
summary: What is changing? On August 31, 2026, we are aligning Shopping campaigns with Performance Max for Retail campaigns by enabling Local Inventory Ads (LIA) by default.
